claims.assertion: Swaruu frames religion as population control that externalizes human agency and lowers perception; she calls it spirituality weaponized against people.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: Gosia suggests some devotees experience their own higher self as Jesus; Swaruu agrees believers manifest what they believe, while leaving the higher self undefined.
claims.speaker: Gosia and Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: Gosia presents the identification as a possibility; Swaruu says the definition needs clarification.

claims.assertion: Swaruu says Jesus can provide some believers hope and emotional support, even as she judges religion harmful to humanity overall.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: She distinguishes personal benefit from broad social effects.
